question: The type of feed primarily used for grooving operations on a lathe is ______feed.
solution:
The correct answer is __Cross**(Feed)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cross feed__ is primarily used for grooving operations on a lathe.
 
• It is the movement of the cutting tool in a direction perpendicular to the axis of the workpiece.
 
• This feed allows the tool to cut grooves into the workpiece at the desired location.
 
• Grooving is a common machining process used to create narrow channels or recesses on cylindrical or flat surfaces.
 
• Proper cross feed ensures precision and accuracy in grooving operations.
 
• It is an essential feed type in turning operations where grooves, recesses, or steps are required.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Longitudinal Feed:**

 
 
• It refers to the movement of the tool parallel to the axis of the workpiece.
 
• It is commonly used for turning operations to reduce the diameter of the workpiece.
 
 
 
• **Angular Feed:**
 
 
• Used in taper turning and similar operations where the tool moves at an angle to the axis.
 
• This feed type helps in creating conical shapes on the workpiece.
 
 
 
• **Rotary Feed:**
 
 
• Involves the rotation of the workpiece or the tool during operations like milling.
 
• It is not typically associated with grooving on lathes.
